# Design System — Extended

## Overview

**Identity:** Milligram
**Summary:** Milligram provides a minimal setup of styles for a fast and clean starting point. Designed for better performance and higher productivity with fewer properties to reset.
**Density:** comfortable
**Layout philosophy:** Centered single-column documentation with responsive grid layouts

### Tone and personality

- minimalist
- clean
- developer-focused
- lightweight
- modern
- simple
- unobtrusive
- efficient

## Tokens — Colors

### Brand

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `purple-primary` | `rgb(155, 77, 202)` | Primary Brand & Action Color | detected; 1.00; web_1 |

### Accent

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blue-accent` | `rgb(84, 133, 182)` | Secondary Accent / Link | detected; 1.00; web_1 |
| `twitter-blue` | `rgb(85, 172, 238)` | Social Accent | detected; 1.00; web_1 |

### Surfaces

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bg-main` | `rgb(255, 255, 255)` | Primary Surface Background | detected; 1.00; web_1 |
| `bg-subtle` | `rgb(244, 245, 246)` | Subtle Block Background / Code Snippet Background | detected; 1.00; web_1 |

### Text

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-main` | `rgb(96, 108, 118)` | Body Text Color | detected; 1.00; web_1 |
| `text-dark` | `rgb(0, 0, 0)` | Heading Text Color | detected; 1.00; web_1 |

### Borders

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `border-light` | `rgb(209, 209, 209)` | Default Border Color | detected; 1.00; web_1 |
| `border-subtle` | `rgb(238, 238, 238)` | Light Separator / Card Border | detected; 1.00; web_1 |

### Gradients

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Tokens — Typography

### Families

- `font-sans`: Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif — Body and Heading Typography (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)
- `font-mono`: monospace, monospace — Code and Snippets (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)

### Type Scale

- `heading-xl`: no measurable values — Hero Main Title
- `heading-large`: no measurable values — Section Headers
- `body-regular`: no measurable values — Primary Paragraph Text
- `code-text`: no measurable values — Inline Code and Code Blocks

### Principles

- Light font weight (300) for clean modern aesthetic across headings and body text
- Clear font hierarchy with high contrast monochrome text against light backgrounds

### Open-source substitutes

- Inter
- Roboto
- System UI

## Tokens — Spacing & Shapes

### Spacing

**Base unit:** Not enough evidence

- `spacing-xs`: 2px — Micro Spacing (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)
- `spacing-sm`: 10px — Small Spacing (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)
- `spacing-md`: 20px — Medium Spacing (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)
- `spacing-lg`: 25px — Large Spacing (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)
- `spacing-xl`: 40px — Extra Large Section Spacing (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)

**Section padding**

- `section-pad-vertical`: 75px — Vertical Section Padding (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)

**Card padding**

- `card-pad-horizontal`: 20px — Card Horizontal Padding (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)

**Button padding**

- `button-pad-horizontal`: 30px — Button Horizontal Padding (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)

### Border radius

- `radius-standard`: 4px — Standard Border Radius for Buttons, Inputs, Cards (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)

### Photography geometry


### Aspect ratios


**Cropping:** Uncropped web preview cards and logo graphics.

## Components

### Button Primary

Solid background primary call to action button.

- `background-color`: rgb(155, 77, 202) — Background Color (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)
- `color`: rgb(255, 255, 255) — Text Color (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)
- `border-radius`: 4px — Border Radius (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)

- **State `default`** — observed

### Button Outline

Outlined transparent background secondary button.

- `background-color`: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) — Background Color (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)
- `color`: rgb(155, 77, 202) — Text Color (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)
- `border`: 1px solid rgb(155, 77, 202) — Border (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)
- `border-radius`: 4px — Border Radius (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)

- **State `default`** — observed

### Code Snippet Block

Light gray container for CLI commands and setup code snippets.

- `background-color`: rgb(244, 245, 246) — Background Color (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)
- `font-family`: monospace, monospace — Font Family (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)

- **State `default`** — observed

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Use lightweight typography weights (300) for clean presentation.
- Maintain high color contrast using primary purple against clean light surfaces.
- Keep borders thin (1px) with subtle rounded corners (4px).

### Don't

- Do not use heavy drop shadows or dramatic gradients.
- Do not mix dark background theme elements on primary landing surfaces.
- Do not dense layout content—maintain breathing room.

## Surfaces

- `surface-main`: rgb(255, 255, 255) — Default Main Surface (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)
- `surface-muted`: rgb(244, 245, 246) — Secondary / Code Surface (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)

**Philosophy:** Clean white base surface with light grey code blocks and sections for structure.

## Elevation


### Borders

- `border-default`: 1px solid rgb(209, 209, 209) — Input and Card Borders (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)

**Philosophy:** Flat UI design aesthetic. Depth is achieved purely through color subtle background changes and light borders without box shadows.

## Imagery


**Visual language:** Vector teardrop outline logo with purple tint and clean screenshots of showcased sites.
**Photography:** Clean desktop screen captures showcasing web apps built with the framework.
**Iconography:** Simple minimalist linear social and utility icons.

## Layout

### Layout values


### Container

- `container-max-width`: 112.0rem — Max Container Width (inferred, confidence 0.80; source: web_1)

### Grid and gutters

- `grid-column-gap`: 2.0rem — Grid Gap (inferred, confidence 0.80; source: web_1)

**Whitespace philosophy:** Generous light background layout with centered content blocks and generous vertical margins to focus on developer readability.

## Responsive Behavior

### Breakpoints

- `tablet`: (min-width: 40rem) — Tablet Breakpoint (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)
- `desktop`: (min-width: 80rem) — Desktop Breakpoint (detected, confidence 1.00; source: web_1)

### Touch targets


### Layout changes


### Image behavior

- Fluid scale to width inside grid layout columns.

## Iteration Guide

- Extend component definitions as form inputs and navigation patterns grow.
- Maintain clean flat styling without unnecessary decorative depth.

## Known Gaps

- `NO_SHADOWS`: No drop shadow tokens were detected in the rendered page styles. (source: web_1)
- `UNSUPPORTED_DIMENSIONS`: Exact pixel dimension tokens for specific heading typography scale were mapped to null per schema constraints. (source: web_1)
- `css-variables-unavailable`: No accessible CSS custom properties were captured from this source. (source: web_1)
- `capture-height-truncated`: The page exceeded the screenshot height limit; lower-page evidence may be missing. (source: web_1)

## Agent Prompt Guide

- Generate Milligram-compliant UI components using thin font weights, 4px border radius, clear white/light-gray surfaces, and purple (rgb(155, 77, 202)) accent buttons.

## Similar Brands


## Quick Start

- Include Normalize.css and Milligram CSS from CDN or npm.
- Apply font-family Roboto and container grid classes for rapid minimalist layout building.

## Evidence

- `web_1` — analyzed, weight 100: http://milligram.io/
